story: phStaging2 story-099 (Balancexit holding pattern). Mainnet broadcast recorded in commit d9d43f6. Previously audited as an entry point in run-38 (L-01 four-address verifier blind spot).

BalancerHoldingBase.authPredicate: _isAuthorized(p) := pooler.poolerAuthVersion(p) == pooler.authVersion() - exactly onlyAuthorizedPooler (VERIFIED against BalancerPoolerV2.sol L136-138)

RevokeBalancerPoolersHoldingPattern.onChainMutation: at most ONE tx: BalancerPoolerV2.incrementAuthVersion() from the Ledger sender (or OWNER prank in PREVIEW_MODE)
preconditions: at least one of the 4 named poolers still authorized, else logs and returns without sending (idempotent)
postconditions: none of the 4 named poolers authorized
notes: vm.startBroadcast() takes no explicit sender: the --sender/Ledger CLI flag decides who signs; the owner check at L108 is against the pooler's owner, not the signer (VERIFIED)
post-conditions are evaluated in forge's local pass (simulation), not against the mined state; the separate verifier is the on-chain check
bumping authVersion revokes EVERY pooler, not just the four named; the four-address list matters only for the idempotence skip and the verifier

checks: each of the 4 named poolers fails the predicate
VerifyBalancerHolding.blindSpot: does not prove that NO address is authorized (any address authorized after the bump via setAuthorizedPooler passes undetected) - already ledgered as run-38 L-01

trustAssumptions: the four named addresses are the complete pre-bump authorized set (run-38 traced them to archives/WhitelistPoolersV2 and Temp.s.sol transactions; not re-derived here)
